name: Pokoge ~Shoku Play no Iseki Oyako Injoku Shokushu Jigoku~
original_name: ポコゲー ～触プレの遺跡・母娘淫辱触手地獄～
source:
In the deep dark forest stands a building with forgotten purpose. But as seal gets weakened, steady ringing starts to sound. The time to regain power draws close, and then...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
幽暗的森林深處矗立著一座用途已被遺忘的建築。但隨著封印逐漸減弱，持續的嗡鳴聲開始響起。恢復力量的時刻正在臨近，然後……
